title: A check refuses JSON.stringify as shell quoting in TypeScript source
body:
Command text wrapped with `sh -c ${JSON.stringify(x)}` gets expanded by the outer shell (t-xasrw18 found it in evals/units/screening.ts). Add a guard or lint check that refuses JSON.stringify as shell quoting in TypeScript source; point to src/repo/shell-text.ts shellWord.
Acceptance: the check fails on a fixture containing `sh -c ${JSON.stringify(cmd)}` and passes on the repository.
Proof: the check test exits 0 with a refusing fixture
